name: Cnoc na Sídha

attributes.attribute: a name meaning the hill of the fairies
the hill Yeats cited stands near Assaroe in Donegal

text: Cnoc na Sídha is an Irish name that means the hill of the fairies. Such names mark heights linked with the dwellings of the fairy folk. The term is generic, so it could fit any of hundreds of hills across Ireland. One link stands out in modern writing. W. B. Yeats cited a hill of this name, and it stands in County Donegal near the falls of Assaroe.

okr.objective: Cnoc na Sídha is the hill of the fairies, a name Yeats tied to a Donegal hill near Assaroe.
key_results: Cnoc na Sídha is Irish for the hill of the fairies.
